matthew_19.chapterTitle: Ministry in Perea: Divorce, Children, and Wealth

events.title: Departure from Galilee
events.description: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee.
events.theologicalSignificance: The transition from the Galilean ministry towards the final journey to Jerusalem.

events.title: Healing in Judea beyond the Jordan (Perea)
events.locationName: Region of Judea beyond the Jordan
events.modernLocation: Jordan (East bank of the Jordan River)
events.description: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.
events.theologicalSignificance: Jesus' compassion and continued messianic miracles even as he approaches the cross.

events.title: Teachings on Divorce, Children & Wealth
events.description: Jesus is tested by Pharisees on divorce, blesses the little children, and speaks with the rich young ruler.
events.theologicalSignificance: Jesus demonstrates authority over the Law, re-establishing the creation design for marriage and emphasizing childlike faith for entering the Kingdom.
